test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Four sentences are given, out of which three have spelling errors. Choose the sentence with all correctly spelt words.

options.text: The Secretary requested to be informed only as necesary to perform his job.
Moving between floors, their journey seems both improbable and inevitible.
The extended phenotype is noticeable when we look at parasites.
They predicted a similarlly miniscule drop for September.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The extended phenotype is noticeable when we look at parasites.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Among the given options, the sentence in option 3 is free of every spelling error.**
 
• The sentence is grammatically correct and all the words are spelled correctly.
 
• "Extended phenotype" refers to traits that are not directly coded in an organism's DNA, but are instead influenced by its genes.
 
• "Parasites" are organisms that live on or inside another organism (called the host) and benefit at the host's expense.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In option 1, "necessary" is misspelled as "necesary".
 
 
• "Necessary" means something that is needed for a purpose or a reason. (ज़रूरी)
 
 
 
• In option 2, "inevitable" is misspelled as "inevitible".
 
 
• "Inevitable" means something that cannot be avoided or prevented from happening. (अनिवार्य)
 
 
 
• In option 4, "similarly" is misspelled as "similarlly".
 
 
• "Similarly" means in the same way. (समान)
